ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with approximately 5-8% high-intensity (white) pixel clusters localized at the distal tips and along the trailing edge boundary.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid dark pigmentation (low-intensity field) across the majority of both lobes. High-intensity circular blobs (white) are mapped sparsely across the interior surface and heavily concentrated in contiguous clusters at the extreme lateral tips (coordinates near top corners of fluke).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an estimated pixel angle of 48 degrees; the indentation depth extends approximately 20% into the vertical span of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge characterized by high-frequency, low-amplitude peaks and valleys (serrations); significant jaggedness is visible along the outer 40% of both the left and right lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly concave trailing edge sweep from the median notch toward the tips; leading edges exhibit a convex upward curve leading to sharp, tapered tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of roughly circular, high-contrast white pixels (barnacle colonies) are situated at both terminal tips; isolated circular rosettes are also scattered across the interior dark field of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, vertical, light-gray linear pixel disruptions (rake-like marks) are visible on the mid-section of the right lobe, oriented perpendicular to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy calcified encrustations (parasitic colonization) forming a jagged, high-contrast border on the distal tips and portions of the trailing edge topography.
other_distinctive_markers: A small, distinct secondary notch or focal bite-shaped depression is visible on the inner-third of the trailing edge of the left lobe, adjacent to the median notch.
